minor.issue: Spec says an empty phone_numbers=[] selection should return count=0, but the current implementation (services/phone_numbers.import_report) treats phones=[] the same as phones=None → wanted set is empty → falls through to 'import every importable row'. The test currently passes only because a prior run already imported everything, so no importable rows remain. If any new importable rows appear later, POST with an empty list will import them. Suggest: `if phones is not None and not wanted: return {'imported': [], 'skipped': [], 'count': 0}` before the loop, and only fall back to 'all importable' when phones is None.

rca of the issue: services/phone_numbers.import_report(phones=[]) currently imports everything importable because `wanted = set(phones or [])` doesn't distinguish 'None' from '[]'. Repro: `curl -H 'Authorization: …' -X POST $BASE/api/admin/twilio/migration-report/import -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"phone_numbers": []}'` — when importable > 0, `count` returns the importable count, not 0. Mitigation: `if phones is not None and not phones: return {'imported': [], 'skipped': [], 'count': 0}` before computing `wanted`. Currently masked because the QA env has 0 importable rows (they were all imported by a prior run).
